nominee.longerDescription: Here's yet another smokin' hot cosplayer! I found her yesterday, but she's very familiar, we might've had a look at her before, but she was certainly not on ww yet. The reason the short description says "Time-travelling", is that yesterday I sent you the post where I found her on IG, and I was like "okay, if bro doesn't notice it in 24 hours, she's getting on ww", and you seemingly didn't, so have fun travelling back to the past, you'll love it 😛
